name: Fukigen na Imouto
source:
Main character is asked to take educational guidance over his relative who does not attend school. The situation unfolds in the way that two young persons share fever this day.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公受托负责指导一名不上学的亲戚。事态的发展，让两个年轻人在这一天共享同样的热度。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
